trails.note: Boardwalk trail; manager's accessibility page says partially accessible from the trailhead to the rock bridge. trails.name: Gans Creek Wild Area Trail
trails.note: Park map summary gives 6.50 mi, orange, rated rugged. Manager's statewide Horseback Riding page calls it 8.5 miles and says horseback riding is permitted only when the trail is dry. The two manager figures conflict; 6.5 is from the newer map. White Connectors 8, 9 and 10 shorten or extend a hike. Bicycle status not confirmed from the manager (third-party sources say no bikes). Other trailhead names not confirmed.

notes: mostateparks.com could not be fetched from this environment (host not in the session's allowed network domains), so everything is from search-result summaries of the manager's trails page, park map PDF (https://mostateparks.com/sites/mostateparks/files/4ROC_ColorMap.pdf), event pages and Horseback Riding page. The manager's trails page lists eight trails: Deer Run, Devil's Icebox, Gans Creek Wild Area, Grassland, High Ridge, Karst, Sinkhole, Spring Brook. The map also shows numbered White Connectors (up to 10), which are official connectors, not separate named trails. Hiker must-know: Devil's Icebox Cave is closed until further notice to protect bats (the boardwalk trail to the rock bridge and cave entrance stays open); horseback riding on Gans Creek Wild Area Trail only when the trail is dry, and biking is described as allowed only when trails are dry; the park has closed for managed deer hunts in early November (Nov. 1-3 in 2025; 2026 dates not confirmed); current trail conditions are posted on the manager's Park and Site Status Map; park office 573-449-7402. No permit requirement for day hiking was found. Per-trail allowed uses were mostly not visible in the manager's summaries and are left null.
